verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's documentation says it blocks all images and CSS by default to speed up requests, and developers can turn this off with `block_resources=false`. That matches the story's default-blocking behaviour as a built-in product capability. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and explicit documentation of the bandwidth or credit savings.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests

citations.quote: By default, and to speed up requests, ScrapingBee blocks all images and CSS in the scraped page, but to scrape them, use `block_resources=false`
